note: Revolution-format motion plan. Exact text, dates, votes, quotes, citations, counters and diagrams are code-rendered in Remotion (never baked into AI stills). Perceptual motion budget (depth >=40%, moving FigureBeats >=6, hero surfaces >=2, ~2.2s cut cadence, ForcefulCut transitions) is verified in the builder BEFORE render, per EP32_carsearch_DESIGN.v001 sec3/sec5.

global.synthetic_label: symbolic reconstruction on all AI reenactment/location sequences

motion_budget.cut_cadence_note: 690s / 314 cuts = 2.197s average (fast). No scene holds a single frame; every still gets DepthStill parallax or Ken Burns, every graphic animates.

reusable_components: BrightLine (carsearch): mode draw|hold|slam — episode-wide motif; slam = Collins NO payoff, Trail motion blur + white flash.
CarCutaway (carsearch): mode all|big|small, zones[] — scope-of-search car diagram, staggered zone lights + mask-reveal labels.
ProbableCauseMeter (carsearch): outcome stall|cross — hunch stalls below the line vs evidence chips cross and lock gold.
CurtilageShield (carsearch): the home's glow expands to wrap the driveway; CURTILAGE mask-reveals.
CaseTimeline (carsearch): events[] {year,text} — 1925 Carroll / 2009 Gant / 2018 Collins doctrine timeline.
CarKeyLock (carsearch): car-shaped key turning in a home-door lock — the most exposed thing unlocking the most protected place.
StateMap (carsearch): label — abstract US cells lighting non-uniformly (smell = probable cause? unsettled).
ForcefulCut (carsearch): mode push|slide|zoompunch|whip, from left|right — every inter-cut transition; NO WipeTransition.
VoteTally (motionkit): majority/dissent — 8-1 Collins vote (8 gold + 1 muted red).
PinDropMap / RouteMap (motionkit): night-grid multiply and 1925->2018 sweep.
QuoteCard (motionkit): exact Taft and Sotomayor lines, attributed.
RegionHighlightMap (motionkit): varied-pattern US map for the marijuana-odor caveat.
ActTitle (motionkit): YOUR RIGHTS ON THE ROAD summary title.
KineticType (base): mask-cut-up kinetic captions with motion blur.
DepthStill (base): per-image depth-map parallax (>=40% of still cuts); depth maps pre-generated by gen_depth.py.
CitationLowerThird / OpenCaption (base): case citations and later force-aligned captions.
